text:
America is the greatest nation in the world because of the men and women who have answered the call to defend freedom. Their sacrifice and unfaltering commitment to our country have protected our liberties.

In Alaska, we have a proud military heritage, and our veterans have played an extraordinary role in both defending our nation and serving our communities. From World War II through the Cold War and continuing to this present moment, Alaska’s strategic role in our national defense cannot be understated. Generations of Alaskans coming from every community - whether urban, rural, or the bush - have proudly served our country in uniform. Our state’s connection to America’s defense runs deep.

On Veterans Day, we honor all who have worn our nation’s uniform and recognize the sacrifices made by their families. 

Their legacy reminds us that freedom is never guaranteed, but is secured through the courage and sacrifice of those willing to defend it. May we never take their service for granted, and may we always honor their sacrifices by preserving the freedoms they fought so bravely to protect.
